title: Paired series — coverage-usage and contested
description: The fourth data layer. Which series pair with which, which side is which, and what each side should be called are research judgements, not display choices — the same class of knowledge as caveat and unmeasured, both of which were moved out of code for this reason. Built when the trigger set in log cycle 31j fired: a second domain (employment) required absence-pairs.

kind.description: coverage-usage is ASYMMETRIC — a records what was delivered, b what it converted into, and the order is the argument. contested is SYMMETRIC — two instruments measuring the same thing that disagree, where neither answers the other and neither may be shown alone.

framing.description: One sentence, specific to this pair. A standing sentence about connections and taps would misdescribe a road network.

gapReason.description: Required when gapComputable is false. Why subtraction is not available — different quantities, different denominators, different populations, or a disagreement rather than a gap.

side.description: Exactly one of series, absenceFrom or competingAccountsFrom must be set.

absenceFrom.description: Series or ledger id whose unmeasured declaration occupies this position — the counterpart does not exist and that is the finding.

competingAccountsFrom.description: Provenance id whose competingAccounts occupy this position — the counterpart is a dispute between sources, not a series.

label.description: What this side IS. Hand-written per pair and never generic: 'The build record' is not 'sustained use'.
